name: superatom-vm
//dependencies: The root imports none of these. They are declared so pnpm links them into the ROOT node_modules, which is an ancestor of every project home under ENGINE_STATE_DIR — that is how agent-written units resolve `@superatom/*`. Agents write those import lines themselves, so the path cannot be baked in the way the seams bake theirs. Delete these and every generated unit stops resolving.

scripts.dev: pnpm run --parallel --filter datasource-manager --filter datasource-demo --filter code-engine dev

//devDependencies: The typecheck belongs to the workspace, not to one app inside it: tsconfig.json at this root covers apps/ and packages/, so the compiler and the Node types have to resolve from here.
